brief: Maths Standard start (root request, 18 November 2026), methods of brief 243
purpose: Proposed whole-course outline for Claude; not a canonical route, design or coverage approval
syllabus: Mathematics Standard 11-12 (2024): Year 11 (common course), Year 12 Standard 1 and Year 12 Standard 2
identifierPolicy: Exact CMS codenames; retain sourceHtml (crosswalk) for official mathematical layout. Year 12 videos list Standard 2 and Standard 1 codenames separately.
courseModel: Year 11 is one course for both Standard 1 and Standard 2. Year 12 videos are built on the Standard 2 actions; a video tagged Standard 1 and Standard 2 also owns the matching Standard 1 points. Standard 1 students need only the videos whose course includes Standard 1 (a Standard 1 playlist can be filtered from the course field).

idPrefixMapping.note: One numbering across the money focus areas, in teaching order: interest, shares, depreciation, loans, credit, annuities (i19 to i23 are Annuities).
z for z-scores; n is taken by Year 11 networks.

year11: Data analysis (d01-d19, can run in parallel)
Networks, paths and trees (n01-n07, can run in parallel)

orderReasons: Formulas and equations comes first in Year 11: substituting into and rearranging formulas is used by pay, GST, interest, measurement and time calculations.
Linear relationships follows because it needs substitution and rearranging, and gradient as a rate of change is reused in pay rates, unit rates and Year 12 simultaneous equations.
Earning money comes before Managing money: net pay from Earning money is the income in a budget, and both use percentages.

Applications of measurement follows the money strands; unit conversions and Pythagoras are needed by Time and location (unit changes), Year 12 Ratios and rates (scales, rainfall, trapezoidal rule) and Year 12 Trigonometry.
Time and location follows measurement because it uses unit conversion and angle measure (15 degrees per hour).

Data analysis and Networks are self-contained after Stage 5 and can run in parallel with the other strands. Data analysis must precede Year 12 bivariate data and the normal distribution (standard deviation); Networks must precede critical path analysis and network flow.

Year 12 starts with Algebraic relationships because exponential models (a05, a06) set up compound interest and declining-balance depreciation in the money strand, and simultaneous equations set up break-even analysis.
Investment, loans and annuities follows: simple interest, compound interest, depreciation, loans and credit cards build on each other, and annuities use the compound interest idea.
Ratios and rates comes before Trigonometry because radial surveys and the trapezoidal rule on site plans use scale reading; trigonometry then extends Year 11 Pythagoras.
Bivariate data, then probability, then the normal distribution: the normal distribution needs both standard deviation (Year 11) and probability language (p01, p02).
Critical path analysis and Network flow come last; they need only Year 11 networks and are short, self-contained strands.
The syllabus listing order is not a mandated teaching order; schools vary, especially in where they place networks and data.

sensitiveContexts.note: Blood alcohol content is syllabus content for 16 and 17 year olds. Frame as road safety and estimation limits, state that P-plate drivers in NSW must have zero BAC, and never present a calculation as a guide to safe drinking.
Medication dosage formulas: state that real doses come from a doctor or pharmacist and the packet; the formulas show how a dose scales with age or weight.
Tax tables, Medicare levy and stamp duty change over time. Each design must name the financial year of every rate it quotes.
